Thanks Marcus -- helpful recap. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- SOC 2: We need SOC 2 Type II evidence for any vendor in scope of PHI processing. We are currently targeting vendor onboarding in Q1 2028; final SOC 2 report availability around Feb 2028 would be ideal.
- HIPAA: yes, PHI will be involved (we're ingesting clinical notes).
- Data residency: US only (we operate in US regions).
- KMS/HSM: we require customer-managed keys (KMS) for encryption at rest; HSM is preferred for the root key.

We attached an initial security inventory from our side. Please note: procurement contact is procurement@acmehealth.com -- they’ll handle the PO/SOW.

Two asks for Redwood: 1) Can you confirm you support air-gapped/on-prem installs with no egress (for an air-gapped option)? 2) Can you provide a short summary of your SOC 2 scope and the controls that cover data handling for private deployments?

If we can get the VSQ back populated this week, procurement has indicated they can prioritize.
